0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder host the Phoenix Suns with Oklahoma City at 3-0, on a three-game winning streak, first in the Northwest and second in the West, while Phoenix is 1-1, 1.5 games back in the Pacific and eighth in the West. The Thunder are without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (ankle) and Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and the Suns are without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, with the most recent meeting a 131-122 Thunder win in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
